findings.claim: A verified Binance News account post dated Oct30 says Binance has begun restoring affected assets to users; it reiterates $5B already held in exact affected token assets, approximately $1.34B remaining to acquire through market/OTC channels, and approximately $3B frozen separately.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: No amount restored, user-credit ledger, XRP-specific allocation, purchase fill or settlement was disclosed. This is a company statement, not independent transaction proof.

findings.claim: Binance Support Update #2 targets an initial PoR snapshot around 2026-10-31 07:33 UTC, withdrawal restoration around 2026-11-01 05:33 UTC subject to security checks, and PoR results by Nov2.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: The restoration-begun statement is not proof that withdrawals resumed or the PoR snapshot was published.

findings.claim: Kodexius at 04:54 UTC reports $734.17M XRP OI across seven contracts, +0.0062% weighted funding per eight hours and $1.25B 24h volume.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Provider-specific contract universe; not a market-wide OI total.

findings.claim: TradRadar at 04:35 UTC reports $1.84B XRP OI across seven exchanges, +0.0068% weighted funding, mark price $1.2437 (-0.77%/24h), at least $2.91M liquidations and 75.6% long accounts.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Liquidations are incomplete lower bounds; account ratios are not notional exposure.

findings.claim: OI divergence persists on overlapping venues: Binance $360.05M vs $414.15M; Bybit $150.78M vs $339.41M; OKX $97.54M vs $108.89M; Hyperliquid $97.44M vs $195.05M.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Contract membership, linear/inverse treatment, price conversion, position aggregation and timestamps are not reconciled.

findings.claim: Investing.com displayed $1.2423 at 00:47:55 UTC and a partial Oct31 row at $1.2425; that observation is several hours older than the cutoff. TradRadar's 04:35 mark was $1.2437.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Not an exchange-execution benchmark; Investing.com row is incomplete.

findings.claim: Research branch head a3db8ba passed actual ledger validation: 337 archive shards, 1,880 sources, 326 run updates, 809 limitations, 24 source references, zero missing and 20 regression tests; fail-closed gate passed.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Validates that exact branch head only; does not establish merge safety or full repository CI.

findings.claim: GitHub compare reports PR #1353 branch history diverged from main, 1,177 commits ahead and 351 behind, despite PR metadata reporting mergeable=true.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: The conflicting signals require a fresh-main migration/split. Do not merge or rebase the existing branch.
